verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents OAuth token generation. Some endpoints specifically require a 'company admin API key', which implies credentials come in different privilege levels, but no explicit scope model is shown. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-key permission selection, guidance on issuing least-privilege keys for agents, key rotation/expiry details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Requires a company admin API key.
